title: Doodling Dumpling Squid
statement: A thumb-sized squid with an apricot mantle and fluttering, scalloped fins, this creature wears its curiosity as traveling freckles that gather wherever it looks. In a twilight-blue tank furnished with one looping porcelain arch, it blows little spirals into the fine white sand, hovers backward to inspect them, then enthusiastically erases a corner and tries something else.
